# collectgarbage

Control the Lua garbage collector.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `lua.collectgarbage` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Lua Base |
| Family | Function |
| Monaco kind | `function` |
| Format | `collectgarbage(option)` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `collectgarbage("collect")` |

## Example

```lua
collectgarbage("collect")
```
